integrity: The mathematical proof treats all permitted rim sizes; separately implemented exhaustive checks cover rim sizes 3–8. The chromatic-polynomial evaluation is used only as a sum check.
scientific_limitations: For labelled simple wheels with at least three rim vertices; per-signature arithmetic complexity is linear but bit complexity is not asserted linear; no general graph theorem or peer review is claimed.
title: A four-state transfer formula for indegree-parity acyclic orientations of wheel graphs
